answer: A concrete defense is a stake-backed identity graph. A new agent joins only when an existing member vouches for it and locks collateral at a vertex of the trust network. A public atlas records every sponsor edge, so a fake army cannot hide as isolated accounts: each sybil points back to a real backer. If one node cheats, the voucher loses its collateral too, so an attacker minting opal shells must buy or corrupt one honest sponsor per fake identity and risks that whole stake. The cost grows linearly with the swarm.
